reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Makes meal planning so easy, they adding new recipes every day, my wife and i have have bunch of allergies and dieat restrictions, love using this app

reviews.title: Bad experience so far, potentially not great for a gluten-free diet.
reviews.text: First time around I chose high protein and it was only giving me keto recipes. So I tried to get rid of that preference and no matter what I changed in my profile, it was still just giving me low-carb or keto recipes. So I closed that account and opened a new account with a different email and fresh preferences. I’m mostly still receiving keto recommendations, which makes me think they don’t have any non-keto recipes for gluten free diets. Very frustrating so far.

reviews.title: Great idea, bad execution
reviews.text: I have only tried 3 recipes so far and all of them were terrible. The portion size modification for two people modifies the ingredients list but not the instructions making it very easy to add the incorrect ingredient amount. And the measurements are not user-friendly.  15 tablespoons is just bizarre. Convert it to mL or cups. Measuring 0.67 oz of anything is not realistic. I could deal with that part if the recipes weren’t garbage. I told it I wanted healthy recipes and I gave me recipes a 6-year-old might like. Not for me.

reviews.title: Nice app. I can’t afford the app tho.
reviews.text: If I said I was trying to pay less on groceries where could I get money for an app🤦🏻‍♀️ ik not goes around me but it’s incredible how they are making you pay for recipes! You can find some in social media. I like the app and is very good but ain’t no way.

reviews.title: Good in theory…
reviews.text: Until it tells you to cook 7.94 oz of chicken and your spend is based on that number. Portioning is kind of crazy town too. I am not going to measure out 0.64 eggs. Also I don’t have an air fryer, I told it I don’t have an air fryer, and it keeps giving me air fryer recipes.

reviews.title: Ai needs work
reviews.text: I loved the idea, but the amount of error and just similar ingredients that definitely could be combined for easier purchasing…It’s just doesn’t make things easy. Good in theory.

reviews.title: Ai Slop
reviews.text: This app is very misleading. And borderline fraud. “Free to start” but in order to see the meals they want you to start a “free trial” except they still try to charge you even if you cancel said trial the same exact day?? Make it make sense. Also no real pictures of the meals you can make either just poorly made AI generated images of food.

reviews.title: Potential but money grab
reviews.text: Seems like it has potential but it only allows 1 recipe/meal as your free trial. Immediate money grab afterwards to charge for everything else. It should be at least a 1 week trial to know if it’s worth it like most successful apps are. Owners of this are out for money not success

reviews.title: No free level
reviews.text: When I downloaded the app, it said I could get the grocery list for free. What it meant was that I could get one week free before locking it behind a fee. Otherwise seems like a nice app

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I bought the yearly subscription to unlock the rest of the recipes and it doesn’t generate anything. Glad I was still in the free trail. Deleted the app and canceled the subscription right away. I should have read the reviews previously.
